title: The Gateway Fog
learning_focus: Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community; refusal and help-seeking.
story_premise: A fog of persuasive messages spreads around the plaza, making risky substances appear harmless or popular.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community; refusal and help-seeking.

areas.title: Message Screen
areas.story: Identify misleading popularity, courage, or stress-relief claims. Match substance use with possible harm to health and judgment in age-appropriate terms.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Message Screen.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Identify misleading popularity, courage, or stress-relief claims.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the signs, think about Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community, then apply the safest healthy action.

learning_clues: Health focus: Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community.
Observe signs, context, and available trusted support before acting.

questions.prompt: What is the healthiest first response in Message Screen?

options.text: pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community
Ignore the signs and continue the unsafe behavior.
Copy another person without checking the situation.
Hide the problem and avoid trusted help.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Use the visible health clues before deciding.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community.
questions.correct_feedback: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community.

questions.prompt: Health clues should be observed before the learner chooses an action.

options.text: True
False

questions.first_wrong_hint: Think about why the NPC, environment, or body signal is shown.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.
questions.correct_feedback: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.

questions.prompt: Select the two actions that support a safe and healthy decision.

options.text: Use the observed clues.
Choose a safe action or ask a trusted person for help.
Ignore warning signs.
Repeat an unsafe choice to see what happens.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Choose actions that reduce risk and use reliable support.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.
questions.correct_feedback: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.

questions.prompt: What should happen after the learner answers the situation questions?

options.text: Apply the healthy action in the game world and observe the result.
Collect the symbol without helping the NPC or area.
Restart the entire mission after one mistake.
Upload the static question text to the server.

questions.first_wrong_hint: PE & Health requires an applied action, not only a quiz answer.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.
questions.correct_feedback: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.

areas.world_action: Apply a safe, age-appropriate action demonstrating Negative effects of gateway drugs on the individual, family, and community.
areas.world_result: The NPC or environment in Message Screen visibly improves after the healthy action.
